text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I replied to Dana in her DM. I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in the Moss notes she has access to:

- **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (`teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md`). Thea Ramaswell filed it on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers at Dock Doors 14–18 in the Eau Claire yard weren't getting SMS bay assignments from the gatehouse kiosk. A patch went in that evening, and Thea confirmed the fix on 5 Oct.
- **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (`teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md`). Thea logged it because gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. The note says it went to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing. This note has no date.

I also told her:
- Two other Moss notes mention the account but give no ticket numbers: the 14 Sep pipeline digest and the 23 Mar renewal check-in.
- I left out Marcus's note on Quarendon Freightways, a different company that isn't a customer.

I only checked the shared files she can read, all of which are public. I didn't search channels or gbrain, because their results include conversations Dana can't see.
